title: Miracle Year at the Patent Office
description: A third-class clerk, four papers in one year, a Nobel that ducked relativity—five steps into 1905's aftershocks.

questions.question: In 1905, a "technical expert, third class" at the Swiss patent office in Bern published four papers that remade physics. Who was he?
questions.explanation: By day he reviewed other people's inventions. By night—his "miracle year"—he produced special relativity, Brownian motion, the photoelectric effect, and the seed of E=mc².

questions.question: One short 1905 follow-up from Einstein asked whether a body's inertia depends on its energy—and gave the world what equation?
questions.explanation: The paper ran three pages. He didn't even write the famous formula in its modern form; the world did that for him.

questions.question: Fame from E=mc² aside, his Nobel skipped relativity as "unproven" and honored his explanation of light knocking electrons out of metal. What is that phenomenon called?
questions.explanation: The committee was still nervous about relativity. Einstein later joked that his prize certificate hung in the bathroom.

questions.question: That photoelectric effect work earned Einstein the Nobel Prize for which year?
questions.explanation: The 1921 prize was held over and announced in November 1922, while he sailed to Japan. The money was already pledged to his ex-wife as part of the divorce.

questions.question: After the 1921 Nobel, Einstein fled Nazi Germany and spent his last 22 years at what independent research center in Princeton—not the university?
questions.explanation: Common mix-up: he was never a Princeton University professor. When offered a salary, he asked them to cut it—he thought it was too high.

imageHint: Wild hair and equations that bent spacetime

easterEgg.title: Technical expert, third class
easterEgg.text: In his miracle year of 1905 he was still a Swiss patent clerk reviewing other people's inventions by day. Special relativity, the photoelectric effect, Brownian motion, and E=mc² all came out of that desk job.
